# Original upstream license texts

These files preserve license notices that are not included in some published package archives, plus artwork notices with terms distinct from the code license. The project license does not replace these notices.

`crate-upstream.json` records source locations and revisions for recovered native package notices. Other source locations are:

| File | Original source |
| --- | --- |
| `ai-sdk-Apache-2.0.txt` | <https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/main/LICENSE> |
| `codicons-CC-BY-4.0.txt` | <https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-codicons/blob/main/LICENSE> |
| `devicon-MIT.txt` | <https://github.com/devicons/devicon/blob/master/LICENSE> |
| `drag-MIT.txt` | <https://github.com/crabnebula-dev/drag-rs/blob/v2/LICENSE_MIT> |
| `fluent-icons-MIT.txt` | <https://github.com/microsoft/fluentui-system-icons/blob/main/LICENSE> |
| `indicator-MIT.txt` | The locked native wrapper package archive, version 0.9.0: <https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/libappindicator/0.9.0/download> |
| `material-icons-notice.txt` | <https://github.com/Templarian/MaterialDesign/blob/master/LICENSE> |
| `MPL-2.0.txt` | The canonical license text included with the locked parser archive, version 0.36.0: <https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/cssparser/0.36.0/download> |
| `remark-math-MIT.txt` | <https://github.com/remarkjs/remark-math/blob/main/license> |

When updating an override, verify the upstream license against the corresponding locked package. Keep original attribution and any additional upstream notices. Font notices remain in `public/fonts/`; the generator includes their complete text in the distributed inventory.
